title: The Strongest Sage with 0 Magic Power: After Mastering Magic Theory, I Became the Strongest in the World
description:
A brand-new “Sage” series from Shinkoshoto, creator of "The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest and My Isekai Life"! Featuring a stunning manga adaptation by Nao Emoto, known for "O Maidens in Your Savage Season" and "New Authentic Magical Girl Risuka".

Born into a prestigious family of mages, Naeton Magius was cursed from birth. He possessed absolutely no magical power.
Despite his condition, he loved magic more than anyone else. Dreaming of becoming a magical researcher one day, Naeton devoted his life to studying and analyzing magic.

One day, he was given the chance to take the entrance exam for the elite Magic Corps through his father’s recommendation.

“...Don’t you think you’re holding back a little too much?”

Having pushed magical research to its absolute limits, Naeton had unknowingly become something far beyond ordinary.

He has no magic power, yet he stands above all!
A rule-breaking fantasy of overwhelming strength begins now!
author: Shinkoshoto
